_comment: Every Verjson/.github contract SHA this repository pins, named by family. This repository is on three contracts at once; a test that keeps its own copy of one of these has already asserted the wrong contract once. Both tests/ai_review_caller_test.py and tests/privileged_merge_caller_contract_test.sh read this file, so repinning a family is one edit and no test can silently disagree with another.
